requirements.title: Rate Limiting and Account Lockout for Auth Endpoints
requirements.description: Authentication endpoints (login, register, password reset, MFA challenge) must enforce per-IP and per-account rate limiting. After a configurable threshold of failed attempts, the account enters a lockout state for a configurable duration. Redis is the authoritative hot-state store for rate-limit counters and lockout coordination across horizontally scaled instances; protected requests fail closed when Redis is unavailable. Lockout state and counter reset must be auditable.
